AIQIF-C1.1.F1.assertion: An approved institutional plan identifies a digital or AI priority.

parts.related: a draft, proposal, vision or mission statement

parts.full: The plan names a digital, IT, e-governance, data or AI priority, goal or initiative
parts.related: the plan names a general modernisation or infrastructure goal that includes technology only implicitly

not_enough: A mission statement alone
A list of completed ICT facilities that is not part of a plan

parts.full: A named role, office, committee or person is assigned responsibility for that priority
parts.related: a body is said to implement or monitor the plan in general, without linking it to the digital priority

not_enough: An organisation chart or list of committees with no stated responsibility for the priority

parts.full: An artificial intelligence or machine learning initiative is named or described
parts.related: the same kind of record for a digital, IT or data service that is not AI

parts.full: A delivery record shows it operating (in use, deployed, running, delivered), not only planned
parts.related: the activity is planned, approved or announced but no delivery record is quoted

parts.full: It operates in an identified institutional function or department
parts.related: the function is implied but not named

not_enough: An AI course or student project (that is teaching, not an institutional initiative)
Funding or incubation of an external startup

parts.full: The review records a decision (continue, expand, change, stop, fund) about that AI initiative
parts.related: the review records findings or discussion without a decision

not_enough: A plan table of generic targets

parts.full: The review reports a measured result of the initiative
parts.related: the review reports activity counts or qualitative impressions only

parts.full: The measured result is compared with the initiative's stated objective or target
parts.related: an objective is stated elsewhere but not compared

not_enough: ICT or institutional KPIs that are not about an AI initiative

parts.related: a later record mentions the decision's implementation without evaluating its effect
